system_configurations.name: RCCL-Bootstrap-TLS
system_configurations.description: Socket encryption (ncclSetEncryption) and bootstrap root robustness. Builds the OpenSSL 3 TLS backend, so configure needs the OpenSSL 3 headers. Single node, 2 GPUs.

tests.name: SocketCrypt
tests.description: Loopback sockets: API contract, wire capture, single-thread ring handshake, full-duplex multi-op, mixed-mode and wrong-key rejection, write-only client close

tests.name: BootstrapTls_Bidir
tests.description: Communicator lifecycle over encrypted bootstrap and proxy sockets, bidirectional ring AllGather

tests.name: BootstrapStrayPeer_Bidir
tests.description: A non-NCCL or non-TLS connection to the bootstrap root does not end it

tests.name: BootstrapTls_Unidir
tests.description: Same over the unidirectional ring AllGather, whose write-only clients exposed the TLS session-ticket reset

tests.name: BootstrapStrayPeer_Unidir
tests.description: A non-NCCL or non-TLS connection to the bootstrap root does not end it
